title: wslua: sandbox dangerous Lua standard library functions
description:
Remove 16 dangerous functions from the Lua environment immediately after initialization to prevent untrusted scripts from:

- Executing arbitrary shell commands (os.execute, io.popen)
- Loading native code (package.loadlib)
- Modifying the filesystem (os.remove, os.rename)
- Terminating the process (os.exit)
- Leaking environment variables (os.getenv)
- Modifying global locale (os.setlocale)
- Leaking filesystem structure (os.tmpname)
- Escaping the sandbox via debug introspection (debug.setlocal, debug.setupvalue, debug.sethook, debug.getregistry, debug.setmetatable)
- Disrupting garbage collection (collectgarbage)
- Leaking function bytecode (string.dump)

Safe functions used by legitimate dissector scripts are preserved: os: time, date, difftime, clock io: open, read, write, lines, stdout, stderr, stdin, close, flush debug: getinfo, traceback globals: setmetatable, getmetatable, rawset, rawget, load, loadfile, dofile, require, pcall, pairs, ipairs, etc.

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body: I can imaging people complaining about this... May still be a good idea though.
Could an untrusted Lua script open an arbitrary file and upload it to a server?

> I can imaging people complaining about this...

Especially people who have written scripts of their own, which they presumably trust not to do anything malicious, that perform those actions.

There should probably be a way to whitelist scripts.
I mixed here, should the different os access be something that should be done trough wireshark? And we add some approve list, how should that be done?

@@ -1804,6 +1804,57 @@ void wslua_init(register_cb cb, void *client_data, const char* app_env_var_prefi
 
     WSLUA_INIT(L);
 
+    /*
+     * Sandbox: remove dangerous functions from the Lua environment.
+     *
+     * Threat model: a malicious .lua file placed in a plugin directory
+     * gets auto-loaded. We remove functions that enable:
+     *   - Arbitrary command execution (os.execute, io.popen)
+     *   - Native code loading (package.loadlib)
+     *   - Filesystem modification (os.remove, os.rename)
+     *   - Process termination (os.exit)
+     *   - Environment variable leakage (os.getenv)
+     *   - Global state modification (os.setlocale)
+     *   - Filesystem info leakage (os.tmpname)
+     *   - Sandbox escape via debug library introspection
+     *   - GC disruption (collectgarbage)
+     *   - Function bytecode leakage (string.dump)
+     *
+     * We preserve functions used by legitimate dissector scripts:
+     *   os: time, date, difftime, clock
+     *   io: open, read, write, lines, stdout, stderr, stdin, close, type, tmpfile, flush
+     *   debug: getinfo (used for script introspection)
+     *   setmetatable, getmetatable, rawset, rawget (used by OO patterns)
+     *   load, loadfile, dofile, require (needed for module loading)
+     */
+    luaL_dostring(L,
+        /* os library: remove command execution and filesystem modification */
+        "os.execute = nil\n"
+        "os.remove = nil\n"
+        "os.rename = nil\n"
+        "os.exit = nil\n"
+        "os.getenv = nil\n"
+        "os.setlocale = nil\n"
+        "os.tmpname = nil\n"
+
+        /* io library: remove command execution */
+        "io.popen = nil\n"
+
+        /* package library: remove native code loading */
+        "package.loadlib = nil\n"
+
+        /* debug library: remove sandbox-escape functions, keep getinfo */
+        "debug.setlocal = nil\n"
+        "debug.setupvalue = nil\n"
+        "debug.sethook = nil\n"
+        "debug.getregistry = nil\n"
+        "debug.setmetatable = nil\n"
+
+        /* global functions: remove GC disruption and bytecode leakage */
+        "collectgarbage = nil\n"
+        "string.dump = nil\n"
+    );
+

@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+-- verify_sandbox.lua
+-- Verify that dangerous Lua standard library functions are properly sandboxed.
+-- These functions must be nil to prevent arbitrary code execution, sandbox escape,
+-- or system disruption from untrusted Lua scripts.
+
+local failures = 0
+
+local function check_nil(table_name, func_name, func)
+    if func ~= nil then
+        print(string.format("FAIL: %s.%s is available (should be nil)", table_name, func_name))
+        failures = failures + 1
+    else
+        print(string.format("PASS: %s.%s is nil", table_name, func_name))
+    end
+end
+
+local function check_exists(table_name, func_name, func)
+    if func == nil then
+        print(string.format("FAIL: %s.%s is nil (should be available)", table_name, func_name))
+        failures = failures + 1
+    else
+        print(string.format("PASS: %s.%s is available", table_name, func_name))
+    end
+end
+
+print("=== Wireshark Lua Sandbox Verification ===\n")
+
+print("-- os: dangerous functions (must be nil) --")
+check_nil("os", "execute", os.execute)
+check_nil("os", "remove", os.remove)
+check_nil("os", "rename", os.rename)
+check_nil("os", "exit", os.exit)
+check_nil("os", "getenv", os.getenv)
+check_nil("os", "setlocale", os.setlocale)
+check_nil("os", "tmpname", os.tmpname)
+
+print("\n-- io: dangerous functions (must be nil) --")
+check_nil("io", "popen", io.popen)
+
+print("\n-- package: dangerous functions (must be nil) --")
+check_nil("package", "loadlib", package.loadlib)
+
+print("\n-- debug: sandbox-escape functions (must be nil) --")
+check_nil("debug", "setlocal", debug.setlocal)
+check_nil("debug", "setupvalue", debug.setupvalue)
+check_nil("debug", "sethook", debug.sethook)
+check_nil("debug", "getregistry", debug.getregistry)
+check_nil("debug", "setmetatable", debug.setmetatable)
+
+print("\n-- globals: dangerous functions (must be nil) --")
+check_nil("_G", "collectgarbage", collectgarbage)
+check_nil("string", "dump", string.dump)
+
+print("\n-- os: safe functions (must be available) --")
+check_exists("os", "time", os.time)
+check_exists("os", "date", os.date)
+check_exists("os", "difftime", os.difftime)
+check_exists("os", "clock", os.clock)
+
+print("\n-- io: safe functions (must be available) --")
+check_exists("io", "open", io.open)
+check_exists("io", "read", io.read)
+check_exists("io", "write", io.write)
+check_exists("io", "stdout", io.stdout)
+check_exists("io", "close", io.close)
+check_exists("io", "flush", io.flush)
+
+print("\n-- debug: safe functions (must be available) --")
+check_exists("debug", "getinfo", debug.getinfo)
+check_exists("debug", "traceback", debug.traceback)
+
+print("\n-- globals: safe functions (must be available) --")
+check_exists("_G", "setmetatable", setmetatable)
+check_exists("_G", "getmetatable", getmetatable)
+check_exists("_G", "rawset", rawset)
+check_exists("_G", "rawget", rawget)
+check_exists("_G", "require", require)
+check_exists("_G", "load", load)
+check_exists("_G", "pcall", pcall)
+
+print(string.format("\n=== Results: %d failures ===", failures))
+
+if failures > 0 then
+    error(string.format("Sandbox verification failed with %d failures", failures))
+end
